name: Dearest Natalia
label: Quest
description: Dearest Natalia: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My dear Natalia has gone missing.

Truth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research.
She was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south.
My soldiers are spread too thin, friend. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Whether she is alive or dead, I must do what is right. She must be found. Alas, I am bound by duty to this outpost. Will you help me once more, friend?
